description.en: The configuration ID. You can call the [ListImageTransforms](~~2869056~~) operation to obtain the configuration ID.

description.zh:
是否开启图片转换。取值范围：

- on：开启。
- off：关闭。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable image transformation. Valid values:

- on: Enabled.
- off: Disabled.

description.zh:
规则内容，使用条件表达式来匹配用户请求。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。存在两种使用场景：
- 匹配所有传入请求：值设置为true
- 匹配指定请求：值设置为自定义表达式，例如：(http.host eq \"video.example.com\")
description.en:
The rule content, which uses a conditional expression to match user requests. You do not need to set this parameter when adding a global configuration. Two scenarios are supported:
- Match all incoming requests: Set the value to true.
- Match specified requests: Set the value to a custom expression, such as (http.host eq \"video.example.com\").

description.zh:
规则开关。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。取值范围：
- on：开启。
- off：关闭。
description.en:
The rule switch. You do not need to set this parameter when adding a global configuration. Valid values:
- on: Enabled.
- off: Disabled.

description.zh: 规则名称。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。
description.en: The rule name. You do not need to set this parameter when adding a global configuration.

description.zh: 规则执行顺序，数值越小越优先执行。
description.en: The execution order of the rule. A smaller value indicates a higher priority.

description.zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~2850189~~)接口获取。
description.en: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation to obtain the site ID.

title.zh: 修改站点图片转换配置

example.unifiedCli: aliyun esa update-image-transform --site-id 1234567890123 --config-id 352816096987136 --enable on --rule-name test --rule-enable on --rule http.request.uri.path.file_name_eq_jpg --sequence 1 --auto-webp on --auto-avif on --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun esa UpdateImageTransform --region cn-hangzhou --SiteId 1234567890123 --AutoAvif on --RuleEnable on --AutoWebp on --Enable on --ConfigId 352816096987136 --Rule 'http.request.uri.path.file_name_eq_jpg' --Sequence 1 --RuleName test
